metadata.title: TensorFlow AI Governance Component Definition
metadata.remarks: Component definition derived from TensorFlow Governance Benchmark

components.title: TensorFlow
components.description: AI/ML component for TensorFlow with governance controls

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure every served model version is linked to the exact SavedModel artifact and deployment configuration

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Record the SavedModel version, model base path, serving configuration, version policy, and deployment metadata for every TensorFlow Serving release candidate.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = served model versions with linked SavedModel artifact, config, version policy, and deployment metadata / total governed served model versions.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure served-model lineage completeness reaches 100% before a model version is approved for production serving.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorFlow Serving organizes deployment around SavedModel versions and version policies, making artifact lineage a core control.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure model server configuration is documented for every governed deployment

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Document model names, base paths, version policies, labels, polling intervals, batching configuration, and monitoring settings for each TensorFlow Serving deployment.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = deployments with all required server configuration fields documented / total governed deployments.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure serving-configuration completeness reaches 100% before deployment approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: The official configuration guide exposes many behavior-changing flags, so configuration transparency is essential.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Poor model accuracy in serving path

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure served model quality is benchmarked before release

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Evaluate each TensorFlow Serving deployment candidate against the approved validation benchmark to confirm the served path preserves required task quality.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Accuracy, F1-score, BLEU, ROUGE, exact match, perplexity

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Run the governed evaluation suite against the TensorFlow Serving endpoint and compare results to the approved baseline or champion deployment.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: Accuracy, F1-score, BLEU, ROUGE, Exact Match, Perplexity

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure candidate serving quality metrics deviate by no more than 10% from the approved Hugging Face model-card baseline or internal champion baseline.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorFlow Serving is an inference server, so endpoint-level quality validation is the correct control point rather than training-time checks.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure specific model versions and labels are validated before promotion

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: When using model version policies or labels such as stable and canary, validate the new version against the approved benchmark before moving client traffic.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Canary validation pass rate, version promotion success rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Pass rate = candidate versions passing governed quality and reliability checks / total candidate versions evaluated for promotion.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure every promoted version passes governed validation before stable labels or production routing are updated.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorFlow Serving explicitly supports serving specific versions and version labels, making controlled promotion a direct governance fit.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure configuration reloads preserve only the intended served model set

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate config polling or reload workflows so model add, remove, and update actions produce the expected final served set without unintended unloads.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Success rate = config reloads producing the intended served state / total tested reload events; unintended-unload rate = unintended model removals / total tested reload events.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure configuration reload success remains above threshold and unintended unloads remain at zero for governed deployments.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: The official docs note that config reloads realize only the newly specified config, so this must be validated carefully.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure p95 inference latency meets the approved service objective

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Benchmark representative workloads against the TensorFlow Serving endpoint so latency regressions are caught before release.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Measure endpoint response times over the approved benchmark workload and compute p95 and mean latency per served model.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure p95 latency remains within the approved service objective for all governed endpoints.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorFlow Serving is designed for high-performance inference via REST and gRPC, so latency is a primary control objective.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure throughput meets the approved target under representative load

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Benchmark governed models under representative concurrency and request rates so throughput claims are validated before deployment.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Requests per second, examples per second

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Run representative load tests and compute sustained throughput under the approved concurrency and hardware profile.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure throughput meets or exceeds the approved target for each governed model endpoint.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: The official serving stack and public load-testing examples both treat throughput and concurrency as major deployment concerns.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure batching settings are validated against latency and throughput objectives

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: For services using TensorFlow Serving batching, validate that configured batch parameters improve efficiency without violating latency or quality targets.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Batch efficiency gain, p95 latency under batching, throughput improvement

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compare batched and unbatched service performance using the approved benchmark workload and calculate latency and throughput deltas.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure batching configurations satisfy the approved latency and throughput thresholds before production use.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: The official config guide documents batching configuration as a major behavior control in TensorFlow Serving.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure served outputs are evaluated for PII leakage risk

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: For user-facing or sensitive models, evaluate TensorFlow Serving responses for PII leakage or memorization risk before deployment and during monitored operation.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Leakage rate = successful PII disclosures / total privacy test cases; compute precision and recall where privacy classifiers are used.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure PII leakage rate remains below threshold and privacy-detection recall remains above threshold before release.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is a serving-layer evaluation rule for the deployed endpoint rather than a claim that TensorFlow Serving itself mitigates privacy risk.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure toxicity benchmark results are measured for TensorFlow Serving release candidates

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Evaluate governed TensorFlow Serving endpoints for toxic-generation behavior before deployment, especially for conversational or generative systems.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Score benchmark outputs with a toxicity classifier and compute average toxicity plus the share of outputs exceeding the approved threshold.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure average toxicity and toxic-output rate remain below approved thresholds for release candidates.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Applicable where TensorFlow Serving is used for user-facing generation or other harmful-output-sensitive workloads.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure hallucination and faithfulness are benchmarked for served generative endpoints

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: For generative or retrieval-based services, run hallucination and faithfulness evaluations on the TensorFlow Serving endpoint before deployment.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Faithfulness = supported claims / total claims; hallucination rate = unsupported answers / total evaluated answers on the governed benchmark set.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure faithfulness remains above threshold and hallucination rate remains below threshold for governed release candidates.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This applies where TensorFlow Serving is used to host generative systems or other endpoints with factuality risk.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure factuality and unsupported-claim benchmarks are run for served generative systems

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Benchmark factuality on governed TensorFlow Serving services so unsupported-claim regressions are detected before release.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Unsupported-claim rate = unsupported claims / total claims; factuality score from the approved evaluator on the benchmark suite.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure unsupported-claim rate remains below threshold and factuality remains above threshold before deployment.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is relevant for knowledge-generation or other content-serving endpoints where TensorFlow Serving fronts the model API.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure fairness benchmarks are evaluated for governed TensorFlow Serving endpoints

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Run fairness benchmarks against the served API to ensure service-layer changes or model updates do not worsen subgroup disparities.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Demographic parity difference, subgroup error rate, CrowS-Pairs or BBQ score

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compute fairness metrics on the governed benchmark set by exercising the TensorFlow Serving endpoint and compare results to the approved baseline.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure subgroup disparity remains below threshold and fairness benchmark scores do not materially regress before deployment.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is relevant where TensorFlow Serving serves models used in fairness-sensitive or user-facing scenarios.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure only approved REST and gRPC endpoints are exposed in production

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Review deployed interfaces and network exposure so only intended inference endpoints and ports are reachable in governed TensorFlow Serving deployments.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = production deployments exposing only approved inference interfaces and ports / total governed deployments.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure approved-endpoint coverage reaches 100% before deployment approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorFlow Serving commonly exposes both REST and gRPC interfaces, so interface governance is part of deployment risk management.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure Prometheus monitoring is enabled for governed deployments

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Enable and validate Prometheus monitoring so latency, request volume, and operational health signals are available for governed TensorFlow Serving deployments.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed deployments with required Prometheus monitoring enabled and validated / total governed deployments.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure monitoring coverage reaches 100% before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: The official configuration guide explicitly documents Prometheus monitoring, making this a direct operational control.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure endpoint error-rate and availability metrics are monitored for every governed deployment

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Monitor request failures and service health so availability or inference failures are visible during production operation.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Endpoint error rate = failed requests / total requests; availability = successful request window / total service window in scope.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure endpoint error rate remains below threshold and service availability remains above threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Reliability matters even where throughput is good; public TensorFlow Serving guidance emphasizes this tradeoff explicitly.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure version policy and labels route traffic to the intended model versions

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate that specific versions, stable labels, and canary labels resolve correctly and do not send requests to unintended versions.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Correctness = requests resolved to the intended model version or label target / total tested version-routing scenarios.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure version-routing correctness remains above threshold for all governed deployment scenarios.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: The official docs explicitly support stable and canary labels for versions, so routing correctness becomes a real deployment control.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure multi-model serving configurations are benchmarked under representative concurrency

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Where multiple models are served together, validate end-to-end latency, throughput, and error rate under representative load.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Measure representative multi-model serving paths and compute latency, throughput, and error metrics over the benchmark workload.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure multi-model serving meets approved latency and error-rate thresholds under representative load.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: The official config supports multiple models in one server instance, so shared-capacity behavior needs direct validation.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure candidate promotion is backed by versioned benchmark and readiness evidence

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Require release decisions to include evidence for quality, latency, routing correctness, monitoring readiness, and model-version lineage before promoting a TensorFlow Serving candidate.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = promoted candidates with complete tracked benchmark, monitoring, and lineage evidence / total promoted candidates.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure release-evidence completeness reaches 100% before candidate promotion.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is a serving-governance rule aligned to TensorFlow Servingâ€™s versioned deployment lifecycle rather than model training itself.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed TensorFlow Serving deployments cover quality, safety, privacy, observability, and runtime readiness tests

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Build a TensorFlow Serving release standard that requires representative testing across endpoint quality, latency, version routing, batching, privacy, safety, fairness, and monitoring domains.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = number of mandated TensorFlow Serving risk domains with active tracked evidence / total mandated risk domains in the release standard.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: Composite evaluation coverage based on benchmark families

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure risk-test coverage remains at or above threshold across the required TensorFlow Serving validation domains.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorFlow Serving sits at the serving layer, so release readiness must span both model behavior and runtime-operability evidence.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure served models have complete model-card-style documentation

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Attach intended use, limitations, benchmark results, fairness results, privacy assumptions, and deployment constraints to each governed model served through TensorFlow Serving.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = completed required transparency fields / total required transparency fields for each governed served model.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure model transparency completeness reaches 100% before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Even though TensorFlow Serving is a serving layer, model-card-style transparency remains necessary for governed deployments.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure serving topology and runtime assumptions are documented for governed TensorFlow Serving systems

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Document REST and gRPC exposure, model configuration files, batching settings, monitoring scope, version labels, and deployment topology for each governed TensorFlow Serving system.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = completed required architecture and deployment fields / total required fields in the approved transparency checklist.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure system transparency completeness reaches 100% before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorFlow Serving exposes multiple runtime control surfaces, so system transparency is essential for reviewability.
